name: Luminara's lightsaber
description: Luminara's lightsaber was the personal green-bladed lightsaber of Jedi Master Luminara Unduli during the Clone Wars. The lightsaber was of a similar design to Plo Koon's lightsaber, bearing a finned radiator casing and ribbed gripping surface. The hilt of the weapon bore marks of wear and tear that attested to its wielder's extended operations in the field.
